docs.purpose: The small admin form that reverts the user lot-size entry of one lot, so a bad entry stops being the lot size every viewer sees (D-4).
docs.data_story: It flips the active parcel_user_inputs row of the lot to reverted (the row stays as history) and writes one admin_audit_log row through the revert contract; the City value is the lot size again.
docs.under_126: **GENERATED.** Rendered by the web FORM binding from render.form and revert_request in lot-size-entry-contract.json.

limitations.what: The admin_audit_log row this surface writes cannot be named in emits.ledger_events[].
limitations.measured: surface.schema.json's emits.ledger_events[] is closed to usage_events events; admin_audit_log is carried in breadcrumbs[] plus a ledger_row_present check (the admin_advertiser_entry precedent).
